newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: Standard lifts prime, home loan rates.
newsitem.headline: Standard lifts prime, home loan rates.

text.p: Standard Bank Investment Corp Ltd said on Thursday it was lifting its prime overdraft and home loan rates by one percentage point following a one point increase in the official Bank rate.
The move, effective immediately, takes the bank's prime rate to 20.25 percent and the home loan rate to 20.00 percent.
Other leading banks are expected to follow suit after the Reserve Bank lifted its Bank rate to 17 percent from 16 percent, with effect from Thursday.
